Select drug ChEMBL ID, preferred name, MeSH ID, MeSH heading, EFO ID, EFO term, and max phase for indication from molecule_dictionary joined with drug_indication. Filter to approved drugs with max_phase_for_ind = 4. Sort by drug ChEMBL ID, preferred name, MeSH ID, MeSH heading, EFO ID, EFO term, and max phase for indication.
